info.name: StayHere Complete API Collection
info.description:
Complete API collection for StayHere MVP — all function apps.

Base URL: https://apim-dev-5c27bcf3.azure-api.net

All endpoints require a Bearer token (Authorization header) unless marked:
  [Public]  — anonymous, no auth required
  [Webhook] — called by Safaricom, no auth
  [Admin]   — requires Admin role

Set the 'token' collection variable with a valid JWT before using.
